globalScope.returnedGrantPresentation: visible and read-only with no mutation control

prohibitedData: client-authored actor, role, permission, Site, or Site Group authority
partialFailure: secondary sections retain successful user detail and render independent loading, empty, denied, unavailable, and retry states
uncertainMutation: retained information is visibly stale and all unsafe controls remain disabled until directory and selected-user authority reload successfully
authorizedLanding: the root opens the first permitted module without weakening any destination guard; no available module produces an explicit authenticated state
siteGroupPresentation: Site Group authority remains distinct from direct Site grants and is not expanded in the browser
responsiveMasterDetail: desktop remains side by side; tablet and narrow selection moves and focuses the selected-user detail before the directory
authenticationFreshness: I-021 uses the normal active H-006 session; privileged-account TOTP is enforced at login and no separate step-up flow is used
atomicUserCreation: user, initial non-privileged role, and required Site or Site Group grant succeed or fail in one Central PMS transaction
assignableRoles: known active Central PMS role codes use business labels; synthetic and test roles are excluded; user type filters compatible directly assignable roles and Central PMS validates the pair
webSession: 30-minute sliding idle timeout with an eight-hour fixed absolute limit; successful authenticated activity is rediscovered through H-006 current-session readback
sessionLoss: H-006 removes the workspace and never replays a mutation
